doc: Cases were executed by calling excalicore.drawio (python/excalicore/drawio.py) via python/tools/gen_corpus_drawio.py; every expected string is Python's own output. `diagram` is {name, fontFamily?, cells}; `cells` are replayed in order as {op: 'container', id, label, box, parent?, style?}, {op: 'vertex', id, lines, box, shape?, parent?, style?} or {op: 'edge', id, source, target, points, lines?, labelAt?, style?} calls (box = [x, y, w, h]; absent options take the function's default). `svgOptions` ({margin?, background?}) is passed to to_svg/toSvg. `expect` is either {buildError: {type, message}} — the LAST cell's call raised — or {drawio: R, svg: R, bounds: [x, y, w, h]} where R is {output: <exact text>} (`.drawio` / `.drawio.svg`, the UTF-8 text) or {error: {type, message}} (the check that to_drawio/to_svg makes, or a style number that does not parse). Error type is the Python exception name; TypeScript throws ValueError with the same message.
